plan.notes: Official four-semester curriculum published on the Madison College program page for students admitted 2026-2027 (program number 101524). The program page lists course numbers and credits per semester but not course titles; titles were cross-verified against two official Madison College documents: the Lakeland University transfer guide (Madison-College-IT-Web-Software-Developer-to-LU-Computer-Science.pdf) and the IT department's official program brochure (it.madisoncollege.edu/brochures/IT-brochure-s2022.pdf), plus the UW-Whitewater articulation agreement. Note: the Lakeland guide titles 10-152-130 'Systems Design' while the older IT brochure titled it 'UIUX for Developers'; the Lakeland title is used. The gen-ed choice slot (10-809-103 or 10-809-166) is published as a 'Complete one of the following' requirement outside the semester lists and is recorded in semester 4; semester totals are 15/15/16/18 = 64, matching the published 'Estimated Time to Complete: 64 Credits'. The two Elective slots list the college's published Recommended Electives as options.
